{"metadata":{"description":"Mochi 🐶 — natural-language CAE plugin for DeepSeek Harness: one sentence in, a full CAD → mesh → solve → post-process pipeline out (CalculiX FEA + OpenFOAM CFD). | 自然语言驱动的 CAE插件：一句话跑通 CAD → 网格 → 求解 → 后处理全链路（CalculiX 结构 + OpenFOAM CFD）。","id":"gh:1344404708","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-cae-plugin","slug":"DaiYuhangSustc/dsh-cae-plugin","topics":["cae","cfd","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Mochi 🐶 — natural-language CAE plugin for DeepSeek Harness: one sentence in, a full CAD → mesh → sol"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ve → post-process pipeline out (CalculiX FEA + OpenFOAM CFD). | 自然语言驱动的 CAE插件：一句话跑通 CAD → 网格 → 求解 → "},{"id":"p1s3","text":"后处理全链路（CalculiX 结构 + OpenFOAM CFD）。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Mochi (dsh-cae)"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**WeChat Official Account** · plugin tutorials and usage articles, published every so often"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Natural-language-driven CAE pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: the agent takes a plain-language simulati"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"on request and drives a complete CAD → mesh → solve → post-process chain over build123d, Gmsh, Calcu"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"liX, OpenFOAM, and PyVista.
Five tools cover the chain end to end — geometry (scripted construction "},{"id":"p5s4","text":"or external STEP import with validation/healing), solid and fluid meshing behind one mode switch, li"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"near static solving plus steady or transient incompressible CFD behind another, result extraction/pl"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"otting, and automated mesh-independence verification — with receipts (paths, volumes, mesh quality, "},{"id":"p5s7","text":"field extremes) fed back to the model after every stage."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Recommended (Docker): install Docker, add the plugin, and point `python` at the prebuilt image — no "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"conda, no apt CalculiX, no OpenFOAM install. The image is pulled automatically on first use (~3–4 GB"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"nda, no apt CalculiX, no OpenFOAM install. The image is pulled automatically on first use (~3–4 GB):"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Local interpreter (no Docker): the routes below."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Python stack first: `pip install build123d gmsh pyvista ccx2paraview`, plus a CalculiX solver — `sud"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"o apt install calculix-ccx` on Debian/Ubuntu or `conda install -c conda-forge calculix` elsewhere (t"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"he `ccx` binary must be on PATH).
For the CFD modes, OpenFOAM (Foundation v11–13 or ESI) must be ins"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"talled; its `etc/bashrc` is auto-detected (`$FOAM_BASHRC`, `/opt/openfoam*`, `/usr/lib/openfoam*`) o"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"r set via `openfoamBashrc`.
Then load the plugin into a profile — run `dsh` from a DeepSeek Harness "},{"id":"p10s6","text":" `openfoamBashrc`.
Then load the plugin into a profile — run `dsh` from a DeepSeek Harness checkout:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- Local checkout (plugin development): `dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-cae` — installs as"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" a `link:` dependency; after changing the plugin, `pnpm build` and restart the surface to pick it up"},{"id":"p11s3","text":".
- Direct git checkout: `dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/DaiYuhangSustc/dsh-cae-plu"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"gin.git` (git installs run the `prepare` build script; pnpm users may need to allow it via `allowBui"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"lds`).
- npm registry (once published): `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cae`."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Each profile holds its own plugin list — repeat the `add` for every profile you use (e.g. `headless`"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ch profile holds its own plugin list — repeat the `add` for every profile you use (e.g. `headless`)."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Launch and use"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- Browser: `dsh web` boots the web UI on http://127.0.0.1:3080 (`--port` to change; it opens the def"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ault browser automatically) — paste a plain-language request and watch the tool calls and receipts s"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"tream.
- Terminal: `dsh --profile headless "20×20 mm square duct, 1 m long, water at 0.02 m/s inlet "},{"id":"p14s4","text":"— steady laminar solve and a pressure contour"` runs one task headlessly and prints the transcript.
"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"A surface started before the plugin was added cannot see it — restart the surface after `add` (or af"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"ter a rebuild, for `link:` installs)."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Try it"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"See examples/cantilever.md: a single Chinese sentence produces a fixed-end cantilever under tip load"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" via `cae_geometry` → `cae_mesh` → `cae_solve` → `cae_post`, with a von Mises contour and a `cae_ver"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ify` mesh-independence check.
And examples/duct-flow.md: one Chinese sentence produces a laminar duc"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"t-flow solution (`cae_mesh` fluid mode → `cae_solve` steady mode → `cae_post`) validated against the"},{"id":"p16s5","text":" Shah–London friction constant."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## The five tools"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Tool | Modes | Input | Output |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| `cae_geometry` | `mode: 'build'` \| `'import'` | build: build123d `script` (defines `part`, option"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"al `NAMED_FACES`) + `name`; import: external `.step` path (+ optional `repair`, `nameFaces` face nam"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"ing) | build: `.step` path, volume, bounding box, named faces with areas/centroids; import: validate"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"d/healed `.step` path, face table (areas/centroids/normals) for BC anchors, optional faces.json side"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"car |
| `cae_mesh` | `mode: 'solid'` \| `'fluid'` | solid: `.step` path, `elementSizeMm`, `elementTy"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"pe` (`tet4`/`tet10`); fluid: duct `lengthMm`/`widthMm`/`heightMm`/`cellSizeMm` (+ `wallGrading`, ful"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"l `blockMeshDict` text, `name`) | solid: `.msh` path, node/element counts, named groups, minimum sca"},{"id":"p19s8","text":"led Jacobian; fluid: `caseDir` (SI bounds, cell count, checkMesh quality, `checksPassed`) |
| `cae_s"},{"id":"p19s9","text":"olve` | `mode: 'static'` \| `'steady'` \| `'transient'` | static: `.msh` path, `material` (`youngMPa"},{"id":"p19s10","text":"`, `poisson`), `constraints`/`loads` on named groups; steady/transient: `caseDir`, `inletVelocityMS`"},{"id":"p19s11","text":", `kinematicViscosityM2S`, `densityKgM3`, dict `overrides` (+ transient time controls `endTimeS`/`wr"},{"id":"p19s12","text":"iteIntervalS`/`maxCourant`/`deltaTS`) | static: `.frd`/`.vtu` paths, `exitCode`, log tail; steady: `"},{"id":"p19s13","text":"converged` + final residuals, VTK path; transient: time-step history, max Courant seen, VTK path |
|"},{"id":"p19s14","text":" `cae_post` | — | `.vtu`/`.vtk`/`.frd` path, `maxima`/`probes`/`plots` queries (+ `densityKgM3` for "},{"id":"p19s15","text":"CFD pressure) | field extremes with locations, probe values, contour PNG paths |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Five tools map onto five Python packages: `src/tools/{geometry,mesh,solve,post,verify}.ts` ↔ `python"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"/dsh_cae/{geometry,mesh,solve,post,verify}` (+ `python/dsh_cae/shared` for receipt emission, the dep"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"endency self-check, and OpenFOAM case assembly). The TS layer owns orchestration only; each tool cal"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"l is a one-shot `python -m dsh_cae.<stage>` subprocess coupled through argv plus the stdout receipt "},{"id":"p21s5","text":"line after the `<<<DSH_CAE_JSON>>>` marker — nothing else crosses the boundary. Two contracts are de"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"liberately mirrored on both sides: the override whitelist exists as the `file` enum of `overrides` i"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"n `src/tools/solve.ts` (`OVERRIDES_PARAM`) and as `CASE_DICT_FILES` in `python/dsh_cae/shared/cfd_ca"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"se.py` — change both in one commit — and `cae_verify`'s per-level loop (mesh + solve + post per size"},{"id":"p21s9","text":") runs in-process inside the single `python -m dsh_cae.verify` process, which is why its stage timeo"},{"id":"p21s10","text":"ut is scaled by 3×levels."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Structural: linear static analysis only, tetrahedral meshes only; CFD: incompressible laminar intern"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"al flow only (steady or transient), block-hex meshes only; POSIX only; single-machine."}],"truncated":true}
